name: Corridor partial device-calibrated load experiment, validated 2026-10-08

calibration.source: docs/WEB_PREVIEW_EXIT_CORRIDOR.md: original 130-second sample; docs/assets/resource-stress/device-observations-20261008.json: fresh identity-verified lifecycle samples. Cost envelopes include the fresh observed maxima; rendering and refresh still use window averages.
assumptions: Render load uses the largest window average, not a per-frame worst-case measurement.
Full LVGL refresh duration (50360 us) is conservatively charged again as a blocking transfer wait, not claimed as pure SPI time.
Frame period is a 110000 us experiment target, not the game timer configuration.
1440 mono-equivalent samples use the 6 x 240 descriptor geometry; effective playable headroom is unmeasured. The ring begins full.
Memory is the observed running-game free heap; only additional allocations are charged. Actual fragmentation is not modeled.
504 us is the maximum synthesis wall-clock duration observed across samples, not a proven worst-case CPU execution bound.
